title: Thai Crispy Lamb Bowl
description: A flavorful Thai-inspired dish featuring crispy lamb, crunchy vegetables, and a sprinkle of magic.

ingredients.name: magical
ingredients.notes: add a pinch of magic to the oil

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, fish sauce, and chili flakes (if using) to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crispy snack to the skillet and cook until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the lamb mixture to a bowl and set aside.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced cucumber and grated carrot to the skillet and cook until slightly tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped mint to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the lamb mixture in each bowl, followed by the cucumber-carrot mixture.
Drizzle the Polish-style sour cream over the top and sprinkle with additional crispy snack (if desired).
